questions.question: What is the primary source of 50 Hz power line interference (PLI) in ECG signal acquisition?

answers.a: Electromagnetic and stray capacitive coupling from AC mains power wiring
answers.b: Thermal noise within the patient's bloodstream

explanations.a: 230V/50Hz mains power lines capacitively couple displacement currents into the human body and lead wires.
explanations.b: Thermal noise is wideband Gaussian noise, not coherent 50Hz hum.
explanations.c: Cosmic rays do not produce coherent 50 Hz sinusoids.
explanations.d: Acoustic vibrations cause low frequency microphonic artifacts, not 50 Hz electrical interference.

questions.question: Why is a galvanic isolation barrier essential in biomedical signal acquisition systems?

answers.a: To amplify the ECG signal by a factor of 1000
answers.b: To eliminate ground loops and protect the patient from dangerous leakage currents per IEC 60601-1
answers.c: To convert analog signals directly into optical laser beams for transmission
answers.d: To increase the power consumption of the front-end amplifier

explanations.a: Amplification is performed by instrumentation amplifiers, not isolation barriers.
explanations.b: Galvanic isolation physically breaks ground connections between patient and mains earth, preventing ground loops and guaranteeing patient electrical safety.
explanations.c: While optical isolation uses optocouplers, its primary purpose is electrical separation, not laser beam transmission.
explanations.d: Medical devices are designed to minimize power consumption.
